create_PaddleOCRVLForConditionalGenerati: create a PaddleOCRVLForConditionalGeneration model with config and quant_config for multimodal image-text generation
build_SiglipVisionModel: build a SiglipVisionModel that encodes pixel values into hidden state tensors using a SigLIP vision transformer
create_Projector: create a Projector that maps vision features from SigLIP to text hidden space with LayerNorm and two linear layers
build_SiglipEncoder: build a SiglipEncoder with stacked SiglipEncoderLayer modules and rotary position embeddings for vision attention
test_encode_image: test the encode_image method that processes pixel values through the vision model and projector to produce image embeddings
